deals.title: Ladies' First Drink Free
deals.summary: Ladies get their first drink free on Fridays

notes: The site mentions a happy hour ('After TASTE Happy Hour', 'Happy Hour, Dinner & Good Vibes!') but gives no days, times, or prices, so it was not included. The 16-year anniversary party is a one-off event and was skipped. The site lists the address as 3094 N Stemmons Fwy, which appears to be the same venue as the 3904 N Stemmons Frwy location.
